arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ ص وَالقُرءانِ ذِى الذِّكرِ
transliteration: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri
translation: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an

arabic: بَلِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقاقٍ
transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin
translation: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism

arabic: كَم أَهلَكنا مِن قَبلِهِم مِن قَرنٍ فَنادَوا وَلاتَ حينَ مَناصٍ
transliteration: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin
translation: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape

arabic: وَعَجِبوا أَن جاءَهُم مُنذِرٌ مِنهُم وَقالَ الكٰفِرونَ هٰذا سٰحِرٌ كَذّابٌ
transliteration: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun
translation: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan

arabic: أَجَعَلَ الءالِهَةَ إِلٰهًا وٰحِدًا إِنَّ هٰذا لَشَيءٌ عُجابٌ
transliteration: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun
translation: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing

arabic: وَانطَلَقَ المَلَأُ مِنهُم أَنِ امشوا وَاصبِروا عَلىٰ ءالِهَتِكُم إِنَّ هٰذا لَشَيءٌ يُرادُ
transliteration: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu
translation: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed

arabic: ما سَمِعنا بِهٰذا فِى المِلَّةِ الءاخِرَةِ إِن هٰذا إِلَّا اختِلٰقٌ
transliteration: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun
translation: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention

arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيهِ الذِّكرُ مِن بَينِنا بَل هُم فى شَكٍّ مِن ذِكرى بَل لَمّا يَذوقوا عَذابِ
transliteration: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi
translation: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom

arabic: أَم عِندَهُم خَزائِنُ رَحمَةِ رَبِّكَ العَزيزِ الوَهّابِ
transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi
translation: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower

arabic: أَم لَهُم مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما فَليَرتَقوا فِى الأَسبٰبِ
transliteration: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi
translation: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes

arabic: جُندٌ ما هُنالِكَ مَهزومٌ مِنَ الأَحزابِ
transliteration: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi
translation: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there

arabic: كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ وَعادٌ وَفِرعَونُ ذُو الأَوتادِ
transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi
translation: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted

arabic: وَثَمودُ وَقَومُ لوطٍ وَأَصحٰبُ لـَٔيكَةِ أُولٰئِكَ الأَحزابُ
transliteration: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu
translation: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions

arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقابِ
transliteration: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi
translation: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified

arabic: وَما يَنظُرُ هٰؤُلاءِ إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً ما لَها مِن فَواقٍ
transliteration: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin
translation: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto

arabic: وَقالوا رَبَّنا عَجِّل لَنا قِطَّنا قَبلَ يَومِ الحِسابِ
transliteration: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi
translation: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning

arabic: اصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَاذكُر عَبدَنا داوۥدَ ذَا الأَيدِ إِنَّهُ أَوّابٌ
transliteration: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun
translation: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

arabic: إِنّا سَخَّرنَا الجِبالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحنَ بِالعَشِىِّ وَالإِشراقِ
transliteration: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi
translation: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise

arabic: وَالطَّيرَ مَحشورَةً كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوّابٌ
transliteration: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun
translation: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him

arabic: وَشَدَدنا مُلكَهُ وَءاتَينٰهُ الحِكمَةَ وَفَصلَ الخِطابِ
transliteration: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi
translation: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech

arabic: وَهَل أَتىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ الخَصمِ إِذ تَسَوَّرُوا المِحرابَ
transliteration: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba
translation: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber

arabic: إِذ دَخَلوا عَلىٰ داوۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنهُم قالوا لا تَخَف خَصمانِ بَغىٰ بَعضُنا عَلىٰ بَعضٍ فَاحكُم بَينَنا بِالحَقِّ وَلا تُشطِط وَاهدِنا إِلىٰ سَواءِ الصِّرٰطِ
transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati
translation: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا أَخى لَهُ تِسعٌ وَتِسعونَ نَعجَةً وَلِىَ نَعجَةٌ وٰحِدَةٌ فَقالَ أَكفِلنيها وَعَزَّنى فِى الخِطابِ
transliteration: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi
translation: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech

arabic: قالَ لَقَد ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤالِ نَعجَتِكَ إِلىٰ نِعاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثيرًا مِنَ الخُلَطاءِ لَيَبغى بَعضُهُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَليلٌ ما هُم وَظَنَّ داوۥدُ أَنَّما فَتَنّٰهُ فَاستَغفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ راكِعًا وَأَنابَ
transliteration: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba
translation: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented

arabic: فَغَفَرنا لَهُ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنا لَزُلفىٰ وَحُسنَ مَـٔابٍ
transliteration: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
translation: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end

arabic: يٰداوۥدُ إِنّا جَعَلنٰكَ خَليفَةً فِى الأَرضِ فَاحكُم بَينَ النّاسِ بِالحَقِّ وَلا تَتَّبِعِ الهَوىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَضِلّونَ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُم عَذابٌ شَديدٌ بِما نَسوا يَومَ الحِسابِ
transliteration: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi
translation: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning

arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّماءَ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما بٰطِلًا ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا مِنَ النّارِ
transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari
translation: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire

arabic: أَم نَجعَلُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالمُفسِدينَ فِى الأَرضِ أَم نَجعَلُ المُتَّقينَ كَالفُجّارِ
transliteration: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari
translation: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked

arabic: كِتٰبٌ أَنزَلنٰهُ إِلَيكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّروا ءايٰتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُوا الأَلبٰبِ
transliteration: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi
translation: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect

arabic: وَوَهَبنا لِداوۥدَ سُلَيمٰنَ نِعمَ العَبدُ إِنَّهُ أَوّابٌ
transliteration: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
translation: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

arabic: إِذ عُرِضَ عَلَيهِ بِالعَشِىِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الجِيادُ
transliteration: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu
translation: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

arabic: فَقالَ إِنّى أَحبَبتُ حُبَّ الخَيرِ عَن ذِكرِ رَبّى حَتّىٰ تَوارَت بِالحِجابِ
transliteration: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi
translation: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain

arabic: رُدّوها عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسحًا بِالسّوقِ وَالأَعناقِ
transliteration: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi
translation: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks

arabic: وَلَقَد فَتَنّا سُلَيمٰنَ وَأَلقَينا عَلىٰ كُرسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنابَ
transliteration: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba
translation: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ اغفِر لى وَهَب لى مُلكًا لا يَنبَغى لِأَحَدٍ مِن بَعدى إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الوَهّابُ
transliteration: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu
translation: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower

arabic: فَسَخَّرنا لَهُ الرّيحَ تَجرى بِأَمرِهِ رُخاءً حَيثُ أَصابَ
transliteration: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba
translation: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended

arabic: وَالشَّيٰطينَ كُلَّ بَنّاءٍ وَغَوّاصٍ
transliteration: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin
translation: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient)

arabic: وَءاخَرينَ مُقَرَّنينَ فِى الأَصفادِ
transliteration: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi
translation: And others linked together in chains

arabic: هٰذا عَطاؤُنا فَامنُن أَو أَمسِك بِغَيرِ حِسابٍ
transliteration: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin
translation: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنا لَزُلفىٰ وَحُسنَ مَـٔابٍ
transliteration: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
translation: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end

arabic: وَاذكُر عَبدَنا أَيّوبَ إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنّى مَسَّنِىَ الشَّيطٰنُ بِنُصبٍ وَعَذابٍ
transliteration: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin
translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment

arabic: اركُض بِرِجلِكَ هٰذا مُغتَسَلٌ بارِدٌ وَشَرابٌ
transliteration: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun
translation: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink

arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُ أَهلَهُ وَمِثلَهُم مَعَهُم رَحمَةً مِنّا وَذِكرىٰ لِأُولِى الأَلبٰبِ
transliteration: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi
translation: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding

arabic: وَخُذ بِيَدِكَ ضِغثًا فَاضرِب بِهِ وَلا تَحنَث إِنّا وَجَدنٰهُ صابِرًا نِعمَ العَبدُ إِنَّهُ أَوّابٌ
transliteration: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
translation: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord)

arabic: وَاذكُر عِبٰدَنا إِبرٰهيمَ وَإِسحٰقَ وَيَعقوبَ أُولِى الأَيدى وَالأَبصٰرِ
transliteration: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari
translation: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision

arabic: إِنّا أَخلَصنٰهُم بِخالِصَةٍ ذِكرَى الدّارِ
transliteration: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari
translation: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter)

arabic: وَإِنَّهُم عِندَنا لَمِنَ المُصطَفَينَ الأَخيارِ
transliteration: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari
translation: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent

arabic: وَاذكُر إِسمٰعيلَ وَاليَسَعَ وَذَا الكِفلِ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الأَخيارِ
transliteration: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari
translation: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen

arabic: هٰذا ذِكرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلمُتَّقينَ لَحُسنَ مَـٔابٍ
transliteration: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin
translation: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end

arabic: جَنّٰتِ عَدنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الأَبوٰبُ
transliteration: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu
translation: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them

arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ فيها يَدعونَ فيها بِفٰكِهَةٍ كَثيرَةٍ وَشَرابٍ
transliteration: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin
translation: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein

arabic: وَعِندَهُم قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرفِ أَترابٌ
transliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun
translation: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions

arabic: هٰذا ما توعَدونَ لِيَومِ الحِسابِ
transliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi
translation: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا لَرِزقُنا ما لَهُ مِن نَفادٍ
transliteration: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin
translation: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away

arabic: هٰذا وَإِنَّ لِلطّٰغينَ لَشَرَّ مَـٔابٍ
transliteration: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin
translation: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end

arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصلَونَها فَبِئسَ المِهادُ
transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu
translation: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place

arabic: هٰذا فَليَذوقوهُ حَميمٌ وَغَسّاقٌ
transliteration: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun
translation: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it

arabic: وَءاخَرُ مِن شَكلِهِ أَزوٰجٌ
transliteration: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun
translation: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)

arabic: هٰذا فَوجٌ مُقتَحِمٌ مَعَكُم لا مَرحَبًا بِهِم إِنَّهُم صالُوا النّارِ
transliteration: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari
translation: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire

arabic: قالوا بَل أَنتُم لا مَرحَبًا بِكُم أَنتُم قَدَّمتُموهُ لَنا فَبِئسَ القَرارُ
transliteration: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu
translation: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight

arabic: قالوا رَبَّنا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنا هٰذا فَزِدهُ عَذابًا ضِعفًا فِى النّارِ
transliteration: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari
translation: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire

arabic: وَقالوا ما لَنا لا نَرىٰ رِجالًا كُنّا نَعُدُّهُم مِنَ الأَشرارِ
transliteration: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari
translation: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked

arabic: أَتَّخَذنٰهُم سِخرِيًّا أَم زاغَت عَنهُمُ الأَبصٰرُ
transliteration: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru
translation: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them

arabic: إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخاصُمُ أَهلِ النّارِ
transliteration: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari
translation: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire

arabic: قُل إِنَّما أَنا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَما مِن إِلٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الوٰحِدُ القَهّارُ
transliteration: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu
translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute

arabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُمَا العَزيزُ الغَفّٰرُ
transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru
translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning

arabic: قُل هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظيمٌ
transliteration: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun
translation: Say: It is tremendous tidings

arabic: أَنتُم عَنهُ مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona
translation: Whence ye turn away

arabic: ما كانَ لِىَ مِن عِلمٍ بِالمَلَإِ الأَعلىٰ إِذ يَختَصِمونَ
transliteration: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona
translation: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed

arabic: إِن يوحىٰ إِلَىَّ إِلّا أَنَّما أَنا۠ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun
translation: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner

arabic: إِذ قالَ رَبُّكَ لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ إِنّى خٰلِقٌ بَشَرًا مِن طينٍ
transliteration: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin
translation: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire

arabic: فَإِذا سَوَّيتُهُ وَنَفَختُ فيهِ مِن روحى فَقَعوا لَهُ سٰجِدينَ
transliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
translation: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate

arabic: فَسَجَدَ المَلٰئِكَةُ كُلُّهُم أَجمَعونَ
transliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
translation: The angels fell down prostrate, every one

arabic: إِلّا إِبليسَ استَكبَرَ وَكانَ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ
transliteration: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena
translation: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers

arabic: قالَ يٰإِبليسُ ما مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسجُدَ لِما خَلَقتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَستَكبَرتَ أَم كُنتَ مِنَ العالينَ
transliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena
translation: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted

arabic: قالَ أَنا۠ خَيرٌ مِنهُ خَلَقتَنى مِن نارٍ وَخَلَقتَهُ مِن طينٍ
transliteration: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin
translation: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay

arabic: قالَ فَاخرُج مِنها فَإِنَّكَ رَجيمٌ
transliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
translation: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيكَ لَعنَتى إِلىٰ يَومِ الدّينِ
transliteration: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni
translation: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرنى إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
transliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
translation: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

arabic: قالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ المُنظَرينَ
transliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
translation: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved

arabic: إِلىٰ يَومِ الوَقتِ المَعلومِ
transliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
translation: Until the day of the time appointed

arabic: قالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغوِيَنَّهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
translation: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one

arabic: إِلّا عِبادَكَ مِنهُمُ المُخلَصينَ
transliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
translation: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them

arabic: قالَ فَالحَقُّ وَالحَقَّ أَقولُ
transliteration: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu
translation: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak

arabic: لَأَملَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena
translation: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together

arabic: قُل ما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ وَما أَنا۠ مِنَ المُتَكَلِّفينَ
transliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena
translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating

arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا ذِكرٌ لِلعٰلَمينَ
transliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
translation: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples

arabic: وَلَتَعلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعدَ حينٍ
transliteration: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin
translation: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof
